rules.rule: Only transport/execution owners may create or mutate execution identity fields.
Business fields are references only and cannot replace execution-to-pipeline binding.
Agent1 owns diagnosis, decision and execution lock.
Action Pack owns executable objects, permissions and numeric limits only.
Agent2 owns one locked-family action draft and cannot rewrite Agent1 diagnosis.
Frontend fields are display projections and cannot drive backend identity.
The V24 operating-plan compiler owns plan and action-node identities; V24.0 registration does not activate runtime planning.
Only the action-node transport owner may materialize immutable V24 plan, node, blueprint and lifecycle Artifact references after a later activation transaction.
Execution-resource context must be assembled from registered evidence and system data; it may not invent budget, ROAS, sample, promotion or logistics values.
Authorization is decided per action node and may block, approve or route a node without rewriting the operating objective or node SOP.
The blueprint compiler owns stage composition and dependencies but cannot rewrite validated Agent2 drafts or Agent3 node SOP content.
Only the stage lifecycle owner may advance stage and node status; frontend navigation is not a lifecycle write authority.
The stage frontend projection is display-only and must render registered stage identities without inferring stages from SOP text.
